hero.bio: I blend structured engineering with visual storytelling to build immersive, responsive web experiences. Specializing in AI/ML integration and minimalist UI/UX design.

about.bioParagraph1: I am an engineer and designer focused on crafting modern, intuitive digital products. With an eye for minimalist typography and clean systems, I bridge the gap between complex software and seamless human experience.
about.bioParagraph2: From full-stack development to modern generative AI experiences, I focus on performance, accessibility, and high visual craft.
about.quote: Design is not just what it looks like and feels like. Design is how it works.

blog.title: Designing Modern Spatial Web Experiences with GSAP and Lenis
blog.excerpt: How physics-based scroll scrubbing, micro-interactions, and 3D layer depth elevate digital portfolios into cinematic experiences.
blog.author: Aaryan Ningdhalli
blog.content: Modern portfolio design has evolved far beyond standard responsive column grids. In 2026, user engagement hinges on fluid interactive micro-moments. Combining GSAP ScrollTrigger with smooth inertia libraries like Lenis lets designers synchronize visual storytelling with user scroll velocity without sacrificing 60fps performance.

blog.title: The Power of Custom Ambient Shaders & Organic Doodle Patterns
blog.excerpt: Why organic doodle typography and contoured ambient textures create memorable brand identity in modern digital craft.
blog.author: Aaryan Ningdhalli
blog.content: Clean geometric lines often run the risk of sterile repetition. By contrasting ultra-sharp typography with flowing, hand-drawn organic contour doodle layers, a designer creates a signature artistic personality that stands apart from boilerplate templates.

blog.title: Bridging Deep Learning Inference with Responsive Frontend UIs
blog.excerpt: Architectural strategies for streaming on-device neural model inference directly into reactive browser interfaces.
blog.author: Aaryan Ningdhalli
blog.content: Deploying machine learning models to the web traditionally meant high backend compute costs and sluggish latency. WebAssembly and WebGPU are changing that paradigm, allowing client-side inference directly inside the browser canvas.
